rules.statement: The value of the claim must be assessed as the aggregate value for stamp duty purposes, even if the claim is for damages only.
rules.supporting_quote: "These cases certainly support the argument on behalf of the Attorney-General and respondent that you cannot read into the Stamp Ordinance provisions contained in the Civil Procedure Code or the Courts Ordinance, and I am of the opinion that in the absence of any explanatory words in the Stamp Ordinance the words 'up to and including Rs. 500' must mean the aggregate value of the claim"
